evidence_kind: Builder observations in the release APK using synthetic originals, plus native and Flutter tests

meaning_query: How soon do I get my rental deposit after leaving

limits: Synthetic inputs are not a retrieval benchmark or independent user acceptance
English upright readable PNG/JPEG text only; no scanned-PDF OCR or object/scene understanding
1 MiB compressed bytes, 4 million pixels, 100000 recognized characters and 2000 passages per image
JPEG non-normal EXIF orientation is rejected; PNG orientation metadata is not interpreted
Native OCR calls lack process isolation and a hard timeout; cancellation is checked around recognition and before commit
Pixel regions were checked in native extraction tests; image highlighting is not implemented
Physical devices, TalkBack, memory and thermal measurements, and hostile-input timing remain unverified
Offline emulator flow and manifest inspection are not a complete OS/service or external-viewer egress audit
